content: Dentate gyrus granule cell layer nuclei are so densely packed they visually overlap in standard confocal/epifluorescence images, defeating threshold- or watershed-based segmentation; specialized 3D boundary-tracing reconstruction algorithms exist as a segmentation-side fix but are non-trivial to implement. Practically, IEG/TRAP2 field falls back to percent-area-occupied-by-signal (binary threshold mask covering DG granule layer ROI) or integrated optical density as region-level substitutes for per-cell counts in this layer specifically.
